quality.missing_policy: No imputation. Segment id increments after every temporal gap.
quality.missing_definition: Absent intervals on a continuous UTC grid between first and last candle; may include scheduled closures, not necessarily data defects.
quality.timestamp_role: candle open; indicators available one minute later
quality.closure_policy: No inferred closure calendar. All gaps remain unclassified; no imputation.
quality.volume_policy: Optional, missing retained as null; never a pattern filter

limitations: Single venue; no Forex or physical/spot gold.
Archive availability is not proof of full listing-to-cutoff coverage.
OHLC does not identify bid/ask, fees, funding, or intrabar path.
Scheduled closures and outages are not distinguishable without a verified calendar.
